He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]]. He was a consensus four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2023 class. Sheppard was drafted as the 3rd pick in the [[2024 NBA draft]] by the Houston Rockets. ==Early life and high school career== Sheppard grew up in [[London, Kentucky]] and attended [[North Laurel High School]].{{cite web |last=Forde |first=Pat |author-link=Pat Forde |date=March 4, 2021 |title=John Calipari, Reed Sheppard and Kentucky's Recruiting Crossroads |url=https://www.si.com/college/2021/03/04/john-calipari-kentucky-recruiting-reed-sheppard |access-date=March 15, 2023 |work=[[Sports Illustrated]]}} He became North Laurel's starting [[shooting guard]] as a freshman and averaged 20.6 points per game.{{cite web |last=Roberts |first=Ben |date=June 28, 2021 |title=Recruiting analysts discuss Kentucky prospect Reed Sheppard |url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-recruiting/article252390388.html |access-date=June 18, 2023 |work=[[Lexington Herald Leader]]}} Sheppard led the state of Kentucky in scoring during his sophomore season after averaging 30.1 points per game in 28 games played.{{cite web |date=July 5, 2021 |title=Reed Sheppard: Louisville showing more interest than Kentucky |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/kentucky/2021/07/05/reed-sheppard-louisville-showing-more-interest-than-kentucky/7768364002 |url-access=subscription |access-date=June 18, 2023 |work=[[Courier Journal]]}} He was named the Kentucky Gatorade Player of the Year as a junior after averaging 25.5 points, 7.6 assists, 6.8 rebounds and 4.4 steals per game.{{cite web |last=Frakes |first=Jason |date=March 16, 2022 |title=Reed Sheppard, UK commit, named Gatorade Kentucky Player of the Year |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/preps/kentucky/2022/03/16/reed-sheppard-uk-commit-named-gatorade-kentucky-player-of-year/7060206001 |access-date=June 18, 2023 |work=[[Courier Journal]]}} Sheppard was selected to play in the [[2023 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]] during his senior year.{{cite web |last=Holton |first=Brooks |date=January 24, 2023 |title=McDonald's All-American Game 2023 roster: Reed Sheppard makes the cut |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/kentucky/2023/01/24/mcdonalds-all-american-game-roster-2023-kentucky-basketball-recruiting/69837834007 |access-date=June 18, 2023 |work=[[Courier Journal]]}} He was named [[Kentucky Mr. Basketball]] after averaging 22.5 points, 8.5 assists and 8.4 rebounds per game.{{cite web |last=Peck |first=Jared |date=March 19, 2023 |title=Reed Sheppard named Mr. Basketball; Haven Ford named Miss Basketball |url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/high-school/article273352545.html |access-date=March 20, 2023 |work=[[Lexington Herald Leader]]}} Sheppard finished his high school career with 3,727 points, 1,214 assists and 1,050 rebounds.{{cite web |last=Frakes |first=Jason |date=March 16, 2023 |title=KHSAA Sweet 16 results: UK signee Reed Sheppard's high school career ends in first round |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/preps/kentucky/2023/03/16/khsaa-boys-sweet-16-scores-and-highlights-from-second-day-of-games/69998188007 |access-date=March 17, 2023 |work=[[Courier Journal]]}} ===Recruiting=== Sheppard was considered a top-50 prospect in the 2023 class.{{cite web|url=https://www.wymt.com/2021/08/29/reed-sheppard-rated-5-star-recruit/|title=Reed Sheppard rated 5-star recruit|first=John|last=Lowe|website=[[WYMT-TV|WYMT.com]]|date=August 29, 2021|access-date=March 9, 2023}}{{cite web |last=Hale |first=Jon |date=November 16, 2021 |title=Kentucky basketball recruiting: Reed Sheppard could join 2023 class |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/kentucky/2021/11/16/kentucky-basketball-recruiting-reed-sheppard-could-join-2023-class/8637051002 |access-date=June 18, 2023 |work=[[Courier Journal]]}} On November 20, 2021, he committed to playing college basketball for [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]] over offers from [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]] and [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]].{{cite web |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |last2=Biancardi |first2=Paul |author-link2=Paul Biancardi |name-list-style=and |date=November 20, 2021 ==College career== Sheppard enrolled at the [[University of Kentucky]] in June 2023, shortly after graduating from high school.{{cite web |last=Drummond |first=Cameron |date=May 31, 2023 |title=This year's Kentucky Mr. Basketball will not play in annual all-star series against Indiana |url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-basketball-men/article275903336.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20241017165852/https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-basketball-men/article275903336.html |archive-date=October 17, 2024 |access-date=June 18, 2023 |work=[[Lexington Herald Leader]]}} He was assigned jersey number 15, his father's number.{{Cite web |last=Roberts |first=Ben |date=July 5, 2023 |title=Reed Sheppard is changing jersey numbers for Kentucky basketball career. Why the switch? |url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-basketball-men/article277003793.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20241017165454/https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-basketball-men/article277003793.html |archive-date=October 17, 2024 |access-date=September 21, 2023 |website=[[Lexington Herald Leader]]}} During the summer before his freshman year Sheppard played for the Wildcats in the GLOBL JAM tournament in Canada and averaged 8.5 points, 5.8 assists, 1.8 steals and 1.3 blocks per game over four games as the team went undefeated and won the tournament.{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4696293/2023/07/17/kentucky-calipari-reeves-wagner-mitchell-globl-jam/|title=How Kentucky basketball changed the conversation with its four wins in Canada|first=Kyle|last=Tucker|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=July 17, 2023|access-date=July 20, 2023}} After the regular season, Sheppard was named [[Southeastern Conference Men's Basketball Rookie of the Year|SEC Freshman of the Year]] by the conference coaches.{{cite press release |url=https://www.secsports.com/news/2024/03/2024-sec-mens-basketball-awards-announced |title=2024 SEC Men's Basketball Awards announced |publisher=Southeastern Conference |date=March 11, 2024 |access-date=March 11, 2024}}{{efn|The Freshman of the Year award is one of two awards presented to the top player in his first season of SEC play. [[Associated Press]] writers who cover SEC men's basketball vote on a Newcomer of the Year award, open to any player in his first season of SEC play regardless of academic classification. The AP award went to [[Dalton Knecht]], a fifth-year senior who transferred from [[Northern Colorado Bears men's basketball|Northern Colorado]] to [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee]] after the 2022–23 season and was named [[Southeastern Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|SEC Player of the Year]] by both the coaches and the AP.{{cite news |url=https://apnews.com/article/all-sec-team-a64c6f42fd83f4dfb4b3cebec5902000 |title=Tennessee's Dalton Knecht named AP's SEC player of year; South Carolina's Paris is coach of year |first=John |last=Zenor |agency=Associated Press |date=March 12, 2024 |access-date=March 12, 2024}}}} At the end of the season, Sheppard was named the national freshman of the year by both the [[United States Basketball Writers Association]]{{cite press release|url=https://www.sportswriters.net/usbwa/news/2024/03/18/kentuckys-sheppard-wins-2024-wayman-tisdale-award-as-national-freshman-of-the-year |title=Kentucky's Sheppard wins 2024 Wayman Tisdale Award as National Freshman of the Year |publisher=United States Basketball Writers Association |date=March 18, 2024 |access-date=March 18, 2024}} and the [[National Association of Basketball Coaches]].{{cite press release |url=https://nabc.com/nabc_releases/2024/nabc-division-i-coach-player-of-the-year-awards-announced/ |title=NABC Division I Coach, Player of the Year Awards Announced |publisher=National Association of Basketball Coaches |date=April 2, 2024 |access-date=April 2, 2024}} On April 18, 2024, Sheppard announced that he would declare for the [[2024 NBA draft]] and forgo his remaining college eligibility.{{cite news |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/39970197/reed-sheppard-enters-nba-draft-leaves-kentucky-1-season |title=Reed Sheppard enters NBA draft, leaves Kentucky after 1 season |first=Jonathan |last=Givony |website=ESPN.com |date=April 18, 2024 |access-date=April 22, 2024}} ==Professional career== Sheppard was selected with the third overall pick by the [[Houston Rockets]] in the [[2024 NBA draft]].{{cite web|first=Sam|last=Quinn|title=Reed Sheppard to Rockets with No. 3 pick in NBA Draft 2024: Kentucky freshman standout lands in Houston|url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/reed-sheppard-to-rockets-with-no-3-pick-in-nba-draft-2024-kentucky-freshman-standout-lands-in-houston/|website=CBSSports.com|date=June 26, 2024|access-date=June 27, 2024}} He signed a rookie-scale contract with the team on July 3, 2024.{{cite web|title=Rockets Announce Roster Moves|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-announce-roster-moves|website=NBA.com|date=July 3, 2024|access-date=July 5, 2024}} Sheppard made his NBA debut on October 23, 2024, in a 110–105 loss to the [[2024–25 Charlotte Hornets season|Charlotte Hornets]], scoring four points.{{cite web|title=Charlotte Hornets at Houston Rockets Box Score, October 23, 2024|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/202410230HOU.html|website=Basketball-Reference.com|date=October 28, 2024|access-date=October 28, 2024}} On January 6, 2025, he was [[NBA G League#Standard assignment|assigned]] to the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]].{{cite web|title=2024-2025 Rio Grande Valley Vipers Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Rio-Grande-Valley-Vipers/14/Transaction_History/2025|website=RealGM.com|access-date=January 7, 2025}} He was recalled to the Rockets after 3 games in the G League with an increased role, including a then-career high of 25 points against the [[2024–25 Oklahoma City Thunder season|Oklahoma City Thunder]] on March 3, 2025, in his first NBA start.{{Cite web |last=Horton |first=Michael |date=2025-03-04 |title=Houston Rockets' Reed Sheppard scores 25 points in first career start |url=https://www.click2houston.com/news/local/2025/03/04/houston-rockets-reed-sheppard-scores-25-points-in-first-career-start/ |access-date=2025-03-10 |website=KPRC |language=en}} Following starting guard [[Fred VanVleet|Fred VanVleet's]] Achilles injury leaving him sidelined for the [[2025–26 NBA season]], Sheppard assumed a larger offensive role off the bench. On November 26, 2025, Sheppard recorded a career-high 31 points in a 104–100 win against the [[2025–26 Golden State Warriors season|Golden State Warriors]].{{cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/reed-sheppard-scores-career-high-31-points-as-rockets-rally-in-2nd-half-to-beat-warriors-104-100/|title=Reed Sheppard scores career-high 31 points as Rockets rally in 2nd half to beat Warriors 104-100|website=CBS Sports|date=November 27, 2025|access-date=April 2, 2026}} On April 1, 2026, Sheppard put up 27 points on a career-high nine three-pointers made in a 119–113 win over the [[2025–26 Milwaukee Bucks season|Milwaukee Bucks]].{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/nba/houston-rockets/rockets-news-reed-sheppard-three-pointer-shy-team-record-win-bucks|title=Rockets' Reed Sheppard one triple shy of franchise record in win over Bucks|website=ClutchPoints|last=Mariano|first=Paolo|date=April 2, 2026|access-date=April 2, 2026}}{{cite web|url=https://www.houstonchronicle.com/sports/article/sheppard-scores-27-points-on-a-career-high-9-3s-22184747.php|title=Sheppard scores 27 points on a career-high 9 3s in the Rockets' win over the Bucks|website=Houston Chronicle|date=April 1, 2026|access-date=April 2, 2026}} Appearing in all 82 games (including 21 starts) for Houston, Sheppard logged averages of 13.5 points, 2.9 rebounds, and 3.4 assists.{{Cite web|title=Here Are The NBA's 2026-26 Iron Men.
